item.title: Proteas thrash Afghans to grab first win
item.description: South Africa finally registered their first win in the ICC Cricket World Cup 2019 by defeating Afghanistan by nine wickets in Cardiff on Saturday. It was not the most convincing display from the Proteas but in the end a good bowling performance led by Imran Tahir meant that victory was a forgone conclusion. item.title: Rohit ton guides India to seventh straight WC win over Pakistan
item.description: Rohit Sharma scored another silky century to lead India to an easy 89-run win over arch-rivals Pakistan during their ICC World Cup group stage match in Manchester on Sunday. item.title: Sarfaraz blames another batting collapse for loss
item.description: Pakistan lost by 89-runs against India at Old Trafford in the ICC World Cup 2019 on Sunday, Sarfaraz Ahmed believes his side gave up all hopes of a win when they lost four wickets in three overs. Pakistan, who at one point were in the chase at 117/1, lost Babar Azam, Fakhar Zaman, Mohammad Hafeez and Shoaib Malik for 12 runs within three overs as Kuldeep Yadav and Hardik Pandya caused havoc. “The credit goes to India’s batsmen and also their bowlers for performing so well. item.title: Ruman becomes first Bangladeshi Archer to win World Cup medal
item.description: Bangladesh’s top archer Md Ruman Shana made history as he became the first Bangladeshi to win a medal in World Archery Championship on Sunday. Ruman ended his campaign on a high when he outplayed Mauro Nespoli of Italy by 7-1 set points in the bronze medal deciding match of men’s recurve event in the Netherlands. item.description: Bangladesh’s ace all-rounder Shakib al Hasan believes that because he is batting higher up the order at no.3, he is getting a better opportunity of scoring big and credits that to one of the reasons he’s been batting so well in the World Cup. item.title: Afghans search for maiden win but face mighty England
item.description: If recent history is to go by, England have been the big team that up and coming teams or as some like to say ‘minnows’ have had success against in World Cups. item.title: Jesus takes centre stage as Brazil win Copa America
item.description: Brazil’s Gabriel Jesus made one goal, scored another and was sent off in the second half as they beat Peru 3-1 on Sunday to win the Copa America for the ninth time in a pulsating contest at the Maracana stadium. The hosts took the lead after 15 minutes thanks to some brilliant skill from Jesus on the wing. item.title: Mithun, Mushfiqur fifties guide Tigers to win in warm-up
item.description: Bangladesh got back to winning ways in their warm-up 50-over match against Sri Lanka Board President’s XI, thanks to a 91 from Mohammad Mithun and a 50 from Mushfiqur Rahim to win by five wickets at Colombo on Tuesday. It was a solid batting display by the Tigers as they chased down a challenging 282 runs with 11 deliveries to spare. item.title: Commodities continue to be dearer
item.description: The commodity price rally, largely driven by the fuel price hike, continued last week with a sharp rise in prices of different essential items, further squeezing the purchasing capacity of limited-income people. The wholesale prices of pulses in Khatunganj went up by Tk110-200 per maund (37.32 kilograms) over the last week, which translated into a Tk5 rise per kg at retail markets.
